name: daydeck-mcp
description: Local MCP server (stdio) that lets Claude Desktop / Claude Code / Cursor read and edit the Daydeck plan.

scripts.bundle: esbuild server.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/server.bundle.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.sync-plugin: npm run bundle && cp dist/server.bundle.mjs ../claude-plugin/daydeck/mcp/server.js && cp SKILL.md ../claude-plugin/daydeck/mcp/SKILL.md
